symbols.read: Price has pushed back above the 742.95–744.11 bear FVG zone that capped the prior read, so the neutral-to-short lean is now stale — that overhead resistance has flipped to support and the immediate bias turns neutral-to-long while price holds above 744. The 4H remains bearish and the 1H trend is still down with the last candle fading (744.57→743.93), so this is a counter-trend bounce, not a confirmed reversal. The 736.65 lower pivot stays the line in the sand: a clean break below reopens 733.68–735.98 (the open bull FVG) and then 714.86, while a reclaim of 758.44 is needed to flip the higher-timeframe case outright bullish. The SELL at 736.65 is invalidated and the regime reads bullish, so the short side is off the table until 744 fails.

Price has recovered modestly to 83,485.21 from the prior 83,266.20, but the structure is unchanged: 4H direction remains Bearish, Combined stays HOLD, and the SELL setup at the 82,285.71 lower pivot has been invalidated without ever triggering, since price never reached entry. The two deep bull FVGs at 81,959.53–82,418.47 and 82,471.18–82,782.95 remain the only untested support, while the 1H uptrend and BULLISH regime persist as the sole constructive offsets. Bias stays neutral-to-bearish: a break below 82,285.71 reopens 80,219.42, and only a reclaim of 84,352.00 restores the bullish case.

ETHUSDT remains a HOLD: the SELL setup at 2,474.34 has been invalidated, and price at 2,517.68 is holding above the 2,474.34 lower pivot with the 1H trend now up, a constructive shift from the prior read's bearish 1H. The 4H direction stays Bearish, so the combined stance is HOLD rather than a clean long, and the last 1H candle is flat (-0.04%), confirming stalling rather than extension. The bearish FVG at 2,546.43–2,553.65 remains the first supply test, with 2,579.88 the upper pivot needed for bullish continuation, while layered bull FVGs at 2,466.47–2,486.84 and 2,451.00–2,463.16 underpin support. Bias is neutral-to-cautious: rejection at 2,546–2,553 keeps the range intact, while a decisive loss of 2,474.34 revives the bearish case toward 2,368.80.

Price has reclaimed the 107.16 lower pivot to 107.76, so the prior read's invalidation condition — acceptance back above 107.16 — has triggered and the outright bearish bias is now void. The 4H direction and combined 4H+1H signal still read SELL, but with price above the pivot and the 107.04–107.41 zone no longer acting as overhead supply, the short thesis has no structural footing. The SELL setup remains invalidated, and with no open FVGs there is no fresh imbalance to trade against. Bias flips back to neutral; re-arming the bearish case requires a 4H close back below 107.16, while 113.40 remains the hard cap that voids the short case entirely.

The tentative buy watch has broken down: price fell from 60.39 to 59.30, the 1H trend flipped from up to down, and the combined signal moved from HOLD to SELL, so the prior bias is revised to bearish. Three open bearish FVGs now sit overhead (59.55–59.63, 59.83–60.03, 60.19–60.21), with the lowest one just above price acting as immediate resistance. The long plan at 61.45 is now effectively dead — that level is far overhead and the 58.50 pivot is the level in play, with a break below it opening the move toward 55.55. Invalidation for the bearish read is a reclaim of 61.45, which would restore the upside case.

Bias shifts to neutral-watch as the setup deteriorates: the 1H trend has flipped down and the combined signal dropped from BUY to HOLD, while price at 4,159.30 has now lost the 4,170.115–4,175.725 bull FVG that was the prior read's invalidation line. That broken shelf has been replaced by a bear FVG at 4,173.19–4,177.56, now overhead resistance capping any bounce, with the lower pivot nudged up to 4,105.50 as the next demand reference. The 4H remains bullish, so this is a pullback rather than a reversal, but the trigger stays a sustained push above the 4,217.40 entry pivot toward 4,329.29, stop 4,210.15. Invalidation: failure to reclaim and hold above the 4,173–4,177 bear FVG keeps the near-term pressure down and leaves the setup dead until price either reclaims that zone or tests 4,105.50.

Price has climbed back to 1.37, tagging the lower pivot that the prior read treated as lost support — the short-side thesis is now neutralized at the level rather than confirmed below it. The 1.3452–1.3608 bull gaps were never filled, and with no open FVGs the downside magnets are gone, so the 1.31 target has no structural path behind it. Bias is neutral: the 4H/1H SELL tag is invalidated and the regime remains BULLISH, meaning the counter-regime move lacks a trigger. Invalidation: a decisive 4H close above 1.37 reopens the long toward 1.43; a rejection here that closes back under 1.3608 revives the short toward 1.31.
